entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I hope so. I need to make a return. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into a return for you. To start, could I get your name, please?
It's David Chen. I bought a pair of your cycling shoes a while ago, and they're just not working out. I feel terrible about it.
I understand, David. To make sure I'm helping correctly, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a sizing or preference issue?

It's the fit. They just give me awful blisters on my heels. I've tried adjusting the cleats, wearing different socks, everything... but they're just painful. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and I saved up for these. I was really hoping for a different outcome.
Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers, and I appreciate you trying to make them work. Do you have your order number handy so I can look up the purchase details?
Yes, let me find it... Okay, it's VF-651-98B. I really need this money back, if possible. The holidays just finished and things are a bit tight.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the cycling shoes, delivered 84 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy.
Alright, David, I have good news. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the window. We can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, wow. Really? That's... such a relief. I was so worried I'd just be out the money. Thank you so much.

Of course. I'm glad we could resolve this for you. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just package the shoes, attach the label, and drop them off at a post office. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be issued to your original payment method. It usually takes 3-5 business days to appear.
That's perfect. You've been incredibly helpful, Diana. This has really turned my day around.
I'm happy to hear that, David. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
